fair.warn.precMismatch: Warning in the MassBank record dialog; {ppm} = difference in ppm, already formatted, between the exact mass of the formula plus the adduct and the spectrum precursor.
export.canvasCap: Warning after a PNG export that was scaled down below the canvas area cap of Safari/iPadOS; w and h are the final width and height in pixels.
app.title: Browser tab title; {app} = program name (from appname.js). Link previews use the title written by tools/build_site.py.
av.cancel: Button of the shared progress panel (avanzamento.js) that stops the operation.
av.cancel.title: Tooltip of the Cancel button of the shared progress panel.
av.item: Item in progress in the shared progress panel; {k} = item number, {n} = total, {name} = file or package name.
av.elapsed: Time since the operation started; {t} = m:ss.
av.left: Estimate of the remaining time, shown only when it is reliable; {t} = m:ss.
av.beat: Sign of life of the progress panel after 2 s without news.
av.stall: Hint of the progress panel after 30 s without news.
av.sum: Summary of the progress panel once the operation is finished (errors and the m:ss duration follow); {done} = items that succeeded, {n} = total.
export.type.chrom: Chart type in the Excel sheet; {kind} = TIC, BPC or PDA.
export.type.spec: Chart type in the Excel sheet; {ms} = MS¹ or MS².
export.file.ions: Part of a downloaded file name (no spaces or accents): number of ions.
export.file.spectrumMsn: Part of a downloaded file name (no spaces or accents): product spectrum; {n} = MSn level (2, 3).
export.file.files: Part of a downloaded file name (no spaces or accents): number of files.
export.desc.chrom: Description in the PNG metadata; {kind} = TIC, BPC or PDA.
export.desc.spec: Description in the PNG metadata; {ms} = MS1, MS2 or MS3.
export.desc.fondoAuto: {text} = description of the automatic background (window in min).
export.desc.axis: {a} and {b} = ends of the horizontal axis.
bgauto.opt: Entry of the automatic background segments menu; {n} = rank (1 = the best), {a}, {b} = ends (min).
bgauto.pick.title: Tooltip of the automatic background segments menu; {lead} = end of the void and solvent front (min).
corr.file: Entry of the Correction menu; {label} = sample name.
corr.file.short: Short label of the Correction button when subtraction of a file is active.
chk.precursorsN: {list} = precursor m/z values separated by commas.
chk.reachesTo: {t} = last RT of the file in minutes.
arrange.where: Announcement for screen readers after a move; {n} = panel number, {r} = row, {t} = total rows, {i} = position in the row, {m} = panels in the row.
disp.xmz: Ion m/z field of a high-resolution XIC in the display options; {input} = the numeric field.
disp.xtol: Interval (half-width) field of a high-resolution XIC; {input} = the numeric field.
disp.xunit: Choice of the interval unit of an XIC (ppm or Da); {select} = the menu.
axis.logSuffix: Title of the y axis with a logarithmic scale; {base} = normal title ("Intensity (cps)").
int.bar.a: Accessible name of the left edge of an integration window (handle to drag with finger, pen or keyboard); {rt} = time in minutes.
int.bar.b: Accessible name of the right edge of an integration window; {rt} = time in minutes.
cursor.handle.value: Value read by a screen reader on the dot of the chromatogram cursor; {rt} = retention time in minutes.
disp.gdelay: Row of the Display options; {input} = numeric field of the delay in minutes.
disp.pdaDelay: Row of the Display options; {input} = field of the delay in minutes.
disp.pdaDelay.found: Outcome of the delay measurement; {delay} = minutes, {n} = paired peaks, {corr} = correlation 0-1.
a11y.line: Description read by screen readers; {title} title, {n} traces, {a}-{b} time, {y} maximum, {p} integrated peaks.
a11y.spec: Description read by screen readers; {title} title, {a}-{b} m/z, {n} peaks.
a11y.mapPda: Description read by screen readers; {title} title, {a}-{b} RT, {c}-{d} nm.
a11y.map: Description read by screen readers; {title} title, {a}-{b} RT, {c}-{d} m/z.
a11y.small: Description read by screen readers; {title} title, {n} series, {xl}/{yl} axis names, {a}-{b} x, {c}-{d} y.
dda.scanAvgOf: Description of the averaged spectrum; {n} = how many scans.
dda.scanNo: Description of the spectrum; {n} = scan number.
dda.ms2Title: Title of the MS2 panel of a DDA trio; {mz} = precursor m/z, already formatted (or ?).
dda.isolation: Isolation window in the description of the spectrum; {w} = half width, already formatted.
dda.scanParent: Description of the MS2 spectrum; {n} = parent scan number.
dda.avgTitle: Title of the panel with the average of the MS2 spectra; {n} = how many, {mz} = m/z of the ion.
chk.transition: Row of the "Does the method match the data?" table; {q1} and {q3} = m/z of precursor and fragment.
calc.toLosses: {v} = absolute value of the calculation result.
calc.add.hit: Line above the adducts table when the observed m/z matches; {adduct} with superscripts (HTML), {ppm} signed error with one decimal.
calc.add.none: Line above the table when no adduct matches; {tol} = tolerance in ppm.
calc.xic.aria: Accessible name of the XIC button of a row; {adduct} = adduct name, {mz} = m/z of the row.
calc.delta.none: Below the field of the difference between two peaks; {tol} = tolerance in ppm.
calc.neutral: Line above the adducts table; {formula} with subscripts (HTML), {mass} exact mass with 4 decimals, {nominal} nominal mass.
dda.mixed: Continuation of dda.none; {n} = number of MS2 spectra that also isolate this ion.
dda.near.line: Line in the triangle box; {min} = window in minutes, {prec} = precursor m/z.
dda.kid.title: Title of the box on a triangle; {i} = sequence number, {n} = total.
dda.avg: Menu entry; {n} = how many nearby MS2 spectra.
dda.avg.tip: Tooltip on the "Average of the MS2 spectra" entry; {min} = window in minutes, {max} = maximum number of averaged MS2 spectra.
dda.kid.prec: Line of the box on a triangle; {prec} = precursor m/z.
dda.list.all: Line above the precursors table when there is no zoom; {n} = number of ions.
dda.none: Message when the ion has no MS2; {ion} = m/z.
dda.win.btn: Button in the header of the Full Scan of the DDA trio; {n} = number of MS2 spectra triggered by the scans shown.
dda.win.avg: Tooltip of the "N MS²" button on an averaged Full Scan; {n} = scans in the average.
dda.win.list: Accessible name of the list of MS2 spectra; {n} = number of MS2 spectra.
dda.win.row1: List row: {i} = position, {prec} = precursor m/z, {rt} = minutes.
dda.win.rowN: List row with several MS2 spectra of the same precursor; {n} = how many, {rt}-{rt1} = minutes.
dda.win.dia1: List row of a DIA file: {lo}-{hi} = isolation window in m/z, {rt} = minutes.
dda.win.diaN: List row of a DIA file with several MS2 spectra of the same window; {n} = how many, {rt}-{rt1} = minutes.
dda.dia.why: Empty MS2 panel of a DIA file: the MS2 spectra are windows, not ions; explains the click on a peak.
dda.grp.title: Box of a flag on an averaged Full Scan; {i} of {n} precursors.
dda.grp.line: Line of the box; {prec} = precursor m/z, {n} = MS2 spectra.
dda.why.avg: Empty MS2 panel, averaged Full Scan; {n} = scans in the average, {m} = MS2 spectra triggered by them.
dda.why.avg0: Empty MS2 panel, averaged Full Scan without MS2 spectra; {n} = scans in the average.
dda.why.zoom: Empty MS2 panel, all precursors outside the m/z zoom; {n} = number of MS2 spectra.
dda.why.none: Empty MS2 panel, no nearby MS2 spectrum; {min} = window in minutes.
cx.applied: Notice after "Apply"; {f} = formula written on the spectrum.
cx.copied: Notice after a click on a results cell; {f} = copied value (formula, RDB, Δ or score).
cx.score.tip: Explanation of the score in the Score header; {w} = weights mass : isotopes : fragments.
cx.remove: Accessible name of the × button of a row of the elements in use; {el} = element.
disp.for: Header of the Display options panel; {type} = chart type (spectrum or chromatogram).
cont.in.one: Contaminant diamond menu; {n} = name of the entry.
cont.in.cls: Contaminant diamond menu; {n} = name of the class.
cont.in.list: Contaminant diamond menu; {n} = name of the list.
cont.ex.cls: Contaminant diamond menu; {n} = name of the class.
cont.ex.list: Contaminant diamond menu; {n} = name of the list.
cont.lb: Button below the HR spectrum; {n} = number of compatible peaks.
cont.lb.aria: Screen reader label of the button; {n} = number of peaks.
cont.cnt: Counter of the peaks hidden by exclusion; {n} = number.
cont.cnt.shown: Counter when the hidden peaks are shown; {n} = number.
cart.found: Notice below the loading box after a folder (several files) has been read; {n} = compatible files, {name} = folder name.
cart.found.one: Like cart.found but with a single compatible file; {name} = folder name.
cart.loose: Notice after files of a .D folder are dropped without the folder; {n} = number of files.
cart.none: Notice when the folder contains no compatible file; {name} = folder name.
cart.method: Sentence appended to the folder notice: several Agilent method folders (.m) recognized, they are not ignored files; {n} = how many, {name} = their names.
cart.method.one: Sentence appended to the folder notice: one Agilent method folder (.m) recognized; {name} = the folder name.
cart.ignored: Sentence appended to the folder notice: files in an unrecognized format, not loaded; {n} = how many.
cart.reading: Progress notice while a dragged folder is being read; {n} = files found so far.
cartp.where: Header of the remembered folder; {name} = folder name.
cartp.denied: Access denied by the browser; {name} = folder name.
cartp.count: Number of files of a group in the list; {n} = how many.
cartp.row.tip: Hint of a row of the list (its name is the visible text: file, state, size).
cartp.error: Error while reading a file of the folder; {name} = file, {message} = reason.
diag.details: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.copy: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.copied: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.copyFail: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.k.phase: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.k.format: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.k.size: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.k.error: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.phase.open: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.phase.copy: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.phase.index: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.phase.decode: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.phase.write: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.quota: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.read: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.memory: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.format: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.decode: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
diag.cause.engine: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice): the WASM engine stopped (trap), it is not out of memory.
diag.cause.unknown: Diagnosis of a file reading error ("Details" block of the notice).
blank.sum: Summary of the blank subtraction. {k} = kept, {d} = discarded, {stat} = maximum/mean, {nb} = number of blanks, {thr} = factor, {min} = minimum detections.
cartp.one.aria: Screen reader label of the "Load" button of a row of the linked folder. {name} = file name.
a11y.uv: Description of the UV spectrum read by screen readers; {title} title, {rt} RT in minutes, {a}-{b} nm, {y} maximum absorbance (mAU).
